first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down and activation is also weakening, so simplifying onboarding targets both linked problems and has prior evidence of improving time-to-value and early adoption. Promotional pricing is the strongest alternative given competitive pressure, but its long-term revenue quality and retention effects should be checked before preferring it for a sustainable qualified-revenue objective.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified source shows completion increased 13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention rose 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected despite acquisition lift because its verified 12% retention decline indicates poor first-renewal durability.
